purpose: Selected-vehicle maintenance schedule, service projections, independent service history/cost evidence, and opt-in Helix narration.
primaryGoal: Review due maintenance and inspect service evidence without confusing defaults, missing measurements, retained results, or estimates with confirmed vehicle facts.

dataSources.behavior: Key ['maintenance', vehicleId], null selection disables automatic reads, AbortSignal forwarded, inherited query policy. Backend validates selected vehicle and returns eight deterministic defaults based on SI odometer; lookup failures become successful empty arrays.

Key ['maintenance-records', vehicleId], independent historical DataState, null gate and AbortSignal. Handler Records at lines 219-222 returns [] unconditionally. No populated producer, record mileage unit, currency denomination, write capability, or server history filtering established.

dataSources.endpoint: useVehicles dependency; its endpoint implementation was not traced in this bounded audit
dataSources.behavior: URL, stored selection, first-vehicle precedence; scoped query identities follow vehicle selection. No competing local picker. /maintenance has vehicle=true and range=false under workspaceScope.

Feature-gated optional narration, positive vehicle scope, stream scopeKey resets on selection change; deterministic sections remain independent. Client endpoint inspected; literal complete backend route not located in router.go and registration was not followed further. No request invoked.

components.reuseDecision: Reuse existing contracts; no evidence supports a new card, table, overlay, stats engine, query owner, or workspace selector.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Source isolation is already extracted and shared by five panels. Similar skeleton and empty recovery composition remains small presentation-specific code, not a reason to add another global wrapper.

sourceEvidence: MaintenanceGridSlot.tsx:15-22 forwards placement to the direct FadeIn grid child
MaintenanceItemsPanel.tsx:44-60 wraps controls; 69-79 uses container-responsive columns
MaintenanceItemCard.tsx:79-143 uses min-w-0, wrapping and responsive metadata disclosure
MaintenanceRecordsPanel.tsx:38-49 uses existing embedded compact paginated DataTable
responsive.verification: UNVERIFIED at all ten required widths. Shared DataTable mobile defaults, table overflow, long select options, large metadata, drawer layout and allocated container widths were not exercised. No source-based assertion of mobile acceptance.

sourceEvidence: MaintenancePage.tsx:150-156 names refresh and hides decorative icons
MaintenanceItemCard.tsx:102-107 supplies named progressbar and numeric bounds

issues.detail: Schedule and refresh request size sm with no local 44px minimum, unlike record inspection. Actual target dimensions and WCAG spacing exceptions depend on shared Button/shell and are unknown.
issues.fix: Exercise target reachability at 320px and compact density; use existing sizing/minimum-target contract if measured targets fail. Preserve actions and names.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus trapping/restoration, screen readers, contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and zoom UNVERIFIED. Shared overlay/motion source ownership is not runtime proof.

states.loading: Five panels supply contextual skeletons; summary supplies OperationalBrief loading state. Independent sources do not replace one another.
states.empty: Successful [] preserves panel shells and source-specific empty bodies; missing disabled/paused sources instead receive generic no-data text.
states.error: Fatal errors are confined through SourceContent with retry; summary surfaces source error independently.
states.retained: Refresh errors/paused fetches preserve rows, show warnings and retries. SourceContent itself supports this at lines 53-69.
states.offline: Paused retained sources are preserved; paused initial sources are presented as generic empty, losing paused-state explanation.

issues.detail: No-data disabled selection and paused initial fetch both map to empty; line 36 replaces page-specific EmptyState/recovery with generic No data available. The manage-vehicles links prepared by downstream panels are therefore absent precisely when enabled=false and no cache exists.
issues.fix: Keep SourceContent owner, but supply distinct localized selection-required/refresh-paused initial bodies and preserve applicable recovery links. Do not turn unknown into authoritative empty or zero.

visualIssues.detail: Eight hardcoded categorical hex accents plus fallback bypass canonical chart palette and persisted chart color choices. Text/surfaces are otherwise restrained variable tokens; category labels prevent color-only meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Coordinate use of existing chart palette with stable category identity and preference preservation; do not introduce another palette or force-reset explicit neon chart choices.

visualIssues.detail: Progress and footer metadata use raw text-xs at lines 92 and 118 despite established Text/caption roles elsewhere.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing typography roles with semantic as overrides, retaining tabular numeric values, layout, accessibility and all metadata.

architectureIssues.detail: The primary Schedule action executes an explicitly inherited no-op. No scheduling endpoint exists in the inspected maintenance route group. This is a current capability limitation, not an audit-authorized invitation to invent CRUD.
architectureIssues.fix: Report limitation and coordinate honest localized unavailable/context guidance while retaining discoverability; wire scheduling only against an established approved capability.

architectureIssues.detail: readOdometer returns 0 for absent cache, failed reads or missing/non-numeric Odometer. defaultItems emits it as current_mileage. Lookup failure also returns [] with 200 (lines 151-154). UI cannot distinguish missing odometer/outage from measured zero or authoritative empty; this is source-side trust ambiguity.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must establish explicit availability/provenance while preserving SI and existing default-item semantics; page must not reverse-engineer unknown from a genuine zero.

architectureIssues.detail: Missing/invalid interval basis becomes numeric 0 in computeProgress (maintenanceModel.ts:58-73); non-completed visual status is then derived as good regardless of source status. Summary/sorting/projections use raw status instead. Backend date-only defaults with no last-service basis consequently appear as measured 0% progress.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve specialist calculations/thresholds for valid inputs, expose unavailable basis separately, and explicitly distinguish derived progress status from raw source status. Coordinate semantics rather than silently changing calculations.

architectureIssues.detail: Selected previewRecord is not scoped/reset when vehicleId changes; line 162 continues rendering the old record while queries switch identity. The current backend emits no records, so this risk is latent for populated retained/future history. Category filter also persists even if the new vehicle lacks its selected option (lines 45,66).
architectureIssues.fix: Reconcile drawer/filter against the new scope using existing workspace identity, preserving all evidence navigation and deliberate valid filters. Do not claim an exercised cross-vehicle leak.

architectureIssues.detail: Empty cost copy tells users to log service records, but inspected history handler produces only [] and page exposes no logging action. A populated record's mileage units and cost currency cannot be verified from this producer.
architectureIssues.fix: State current source limitation honestly and preserve history/cost/evidence renderers for real future data; do not invent record writes, currency conversion or mileage adapters.

priority.reason: Data-trust and nonfunctional primary-action limitations outrank cosmetic modernization. Most existing layout and component reuse is already established; runtime acceptance remains open.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Maintenance source availability/provenance contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Explicit unknown odometer versus measured zero; unavailable lookup versus authoritative empty; default schedule provenance. Preserve SI raw values, query keys, AbortSignal and independent retained/fatal states.
dependsOn: Backend/API integration owner approval and typed contract; no page-local inference or fabricated capability

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical categorical maintenance palette adoption
requiredSharedChanges.existingOwnerFile: web\src\lib\colors.ts (canonical owner identified by design contract; implementation not inspected)
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Stable category-to-color assignment, neutral unknown fallback, saved palette/custom-choice preservation, semantic status colors separate from category accents.
dependsOn: Existing chart-palette owner coordination; no new component or color engine

competingImplementations.detail: Another useMaintenance/useServiceRecords pair requests the same endpoint family without selected-vehicle parameters, uses different keys and explicit retry=false/static policy. Assigned page uses dedicated scoped useMaintenance.ts. Do not opportunistically consolidate or alter other consumers in this audit.

preservation.lineCountScope: Root plus all 16 direct files in maintenance-modernization, including barrel/model/presentation; excludes tests and shared components. Historical baseline comparison not available and not claimed.
actions: DataTable pagination, sorting, value filters and saved column/export pipeline
Vehicle, drives, charging, locations, inbox, signals and service-evidence navigation
dataBehavior: Keep existing selected-vehicle workspace owner; no second selector and no speculative date scope.
Preserve raw query/cache objects and keys, enablement, cancellation and inherited policies.
Maintenance distance fields, including legacy interval_miles name, carry SI metres; useUnits formats at render boundary. Do not rename wire shape or add legacy converters.
Record mileage producer/unit and currency denomination remain unknown, not assumed or corrected.
Summary uses all returned items before filter, including completed count and distinct category count.
Copy-sort arrays; preserve status sort order and specialist 30.44-day interval denominator, 70/90 thresholds and clamp for established valid inputs.
Projections retain eligibility, overdue-first sorting, remaining SI distance and eight-row horizon.
Cost estimates retain all-record denominator, valid-date span and 0.1-year minimum; fewer than two valid dates uses total cost.
Category bars retain largest-category denominator rather than total-item percentage.
Preserve tableId vehicle-systems:maintenance-records, original column keys and full metadata/evidence links.
AI gating, redaction explanation and scope-reset behavior remain independent of deterministic maintenance sections.

evidenceLimits.method: Bounded Phase 0 source-only audit; no application started, no network invocation, no mutation, no Git or queue operations.
evidenceLimits.typescript: NOTRUN: audit assignment prohibits project-wide validation; source inspection does not establish type correctness.
evidenceLimits.skillAuditScript: NOTRUN: inspected audit.sh unconditionally invokes full frontend tsc. Replaced with bounded read-only pattern inspection; no full lint/build/test run.
evidenceLimits.patternCaveat: Select-String initial case-insensitive raw-control probe matched five uppercase shared Button/Select uses; corrected -CaseSensitive probe returned 0. Counts cover root and direct maintenance-modernization files only, not shared implementations.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only assigned page endpoint handlers/router fragments inspected. Redis freshness plumbing, populated records, AI registration chain and other consumers not fully traced.
evidenceLimits.historicalEvidence: No old test receipts or comments treated as runtime proof.
